newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's public sector debt down to $29 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's public sector debt down to $29 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's public sector external debt is expected to total about $29 billion at the end of the year, down from $31 billion at the end of 1995, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said.
"In general terms ... the public sector external debt will end the year at around $29 billion," he told a news conference.
Matos gave no details, but he said on Wednesday that Venezuela had no debt arrears in 1996 and paid $654 million this year on debt due since 1991.

He also explained to the Foreign Press Association Wednesday that the government intended to design a global strategy to drastically reduce debt service, from 45 percent of total ordinary revenue in 1996 to 25 percent from the year 2000.
